source_notes: Agent-authored in-person private-pair draft concepts and RU/EN/TR draft localizations. Assumes an already available mutually chosen private moment; does not instruct leaving, isolation, contact or disclosure. No external card collection used. Human originality, rights, safety, cultural suitability, similarity, diversity and tri-locale review NOT performed; not approved or publishable.
